topic: Airplane Mode Doesn't Actually Stop Your Phone From Being Tracked
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know Airplane Mode Doesn't Fully Disable Tracking? ✈️

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 The baseband modem chip in smartphones can operate independently from the main processor. Some phones can still be pinged by cell towers even in airplane mode if the baseband firmware allows it.
